input.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty from 15 to 90 days and remove the post-period cut-off of correction/refund duties.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Deliverable conformance warranty to ninety (90) days, as fifteen days is shorter than our minimum warranty duration and barely exceeds the acceptance testing window in Section 6.1. We also removed the language cutting off all correction and refund obligations, since that would override the general conformance warranty in Section 19.1 and the remedy in Section 19.4.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation. Nothing in this Section limits the warranties in Section 19.1 or 19.3 or the remedies in Sections 6.2 and 19.4.
